note: Identity roster for audit-agencysignature-main-tip.ts (fail-CLOSED exemption list).
READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A ROW. This file lists the ONLY identities that may be
EXEMPT from carrying an AgencySignature trailer. It is deliberately NOT a list of
agents. The auditor's previous defect was an ALLOWLIST OF AGENTS: a commit whose
Co-authored-by did not match Claude|Codex|Grok|Gemini|Kiro fell through to
'assuming human-authored' and was exempted. That is fail-OPEN -- every persona the
fleet adds is silently exempt until someone audits the auditor. Measured on
origin/main 2026-08-14, it exempted 39 github-actions[bot] commits and 6 commits
trailed with the fleet's own personas (Dejan, Soraya, the shadow, Otto).
The inversion: exemption now requires a POSITIVE match in this file. An identity
nobody listed is agent-or-unknown and MUST sign. A stale roster therefore produces
a FALSE REGRESSION (loud, one-line diff to fix) instead of a FALSE EXEMPTION
(silent, indefinite). That asymmetry is the entire point of the file.
MATCHED ON Co-authored-by ONLY -- never on the git author field. 155 of the last
300 commits on origin/main are authored 'Aaron Stainback <aaron_bond@yahoo.com>'
and committed by 'GitHub <noreply@github.com>': that is GitHub's squash-merge
attribution of AGENT pull requests to the merging human's account. Treating the
author field as a human signal would exempt the majority of main. The one
exception is machineLanes, which may also match author/committer, and only for a
commit that carries no Co-authored-by at all (the direct-push telemetry lanes).
Comparison is on the e-mail address, lowercased (ASCII), exact. Display names are
informational only.
RESIDUAL HOLE, stated rather than papered over: a commit produced by an agent but
pushed through a human's GitHub credential is attributed by GitHub to that human,
and this roster will exempt it. The credential is the human-authorization boundary
in this repo, so that is the intended reading -- but it is an inference from the
credential, not evidence a human wrote the diff. The HUMAN-ROSTER-EXEMPT count is
printed in every audit summary so the size of that inference stays visible.
